title: Hunt's deathbed confession of a conspiracy to kill Kennedy

tellings.quote: I know that eh Howard Hunt on his deathbed did claim that there was a conspiracy to kill Kennedy that he knew about it.

related.note: The same deathbed confession by Hunt, but Levenda says only that Hunt admitted knowing of a conspiracy to kill Kennedy, with no UFO motive.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that E. Howard Hunt, a former officer of the CIA, the US spy agency, claimed on his deathbed that there had been a plot to kill President John F. Kennedy, who was shot in 1963. Levenda says Hunt claimed he knew about it. If true, it would mean the killing was planned by more than one man.
